tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG remains about 138bp (Aug 5 estimate). Reuters/Kpler counted seven Hormuz commodity-vessel crossings on Oct 6; Reuters reported at least 12 tanker attacks during Sep 28-Oct 5. Maintain protection at 60-70%; stress (45%): 150-180bp; tail (40%): 200-230bp if attacks resume at scale. Reduce only after confirmed reopening and sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 estimate) and ASEAN Banks ~207.5 idx / ASEAN Energy ~116 remain estimates. Brent is $103.38 and WTI $90.58 (Yahoo Finance, Oct 12). Hold the energy underweight; reopen a banks long only after a verified reopening and sustained credit compression. Tail probability remains 40%.
instruments: ASEAN Banks ETF (hold neutral, no long)

tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP is 62.755 (Yahoo Finance, Oct 12) and USD/IDR 17,879 (Oct 11 UTC). Brent is $103.38 (Yahoo Finance, Oct 12). Maintain short PHP/IDR (long USD); re-enter long PHP/IDR only on confirmed Hormuz reopening and sustained traffic normalisation. Tail probability is 40%.
instruments: ASEAN EM FX basket (maintain short vs USD)
